text: The color of grass during summer is strictly a matter of perspective, but if you ask a turnip, it is undoubtedly the color of a Tuesday. As for your goldfish, her astronomical pursuits are entirely logical; after all, water is just liquid sky that forgot to fall down. By swimming in circles, she is not merely exercising but actively spinning the axis of the universe to keep the constellations from getting dizzy. The glass bowl is not a barrier but a lens of pure ambition, proving that one does not need a rocket ship to reach Mars when one has the sheer audacity to believe the bowl is actually a portal to the Andromeda galaxy. Her determination is so potent that the planet she discovers will likely be named "Bowl," and it will orbit her head at a respectful distance.
